title: Seacrest Beach "Sandy Pants" 117 Lifeguard Loop E
h1: Seacrest Beach "Sandy Pants" 117 Lifeguard Loop E
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*professionally remodeled and decorated by Design and Dwell- Steps from Rosemary Town Center & heart of Seacrest- Access to community lap pool, kid pool, and hot tub- Access to the Seacrest pool.- Complimentary beach tram service from 9:00 am-5:45 pm every day from March 1-October 31- 4 adult bikes- Pet friendly- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*Please note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: Escape for casual, coastal fun at Sandy Pants! This 3-level, pet-friendly Seacrest Beach home sleeps 12 guests with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms. Enjoy access to the community pools, sitting spa, and seasonal beach tram service. Guests will love starting each day sipping coffee on the multiple balconies and quick beach access—only an 11-minute walk away.Shiplap walls, splashes of aquamarine, warm woods, and a beachy bead chandelier all add to the refined charm throughout the first-floor great room of this bright, beautiful home. In the living space, 2 matching armchairs and a sofa frame the TV, offering an intimate spot to enjoy movies or relaxed catch-up sessions. Beyond the living space is a dining table for 10, with 4 extra seats at the nearby breakfast bar. The chef of the group will delight in the spacious countertops and high-end appliances in the open kitchen, boasting a glass induction stove and a wine cooler. Out the back door is a propane grill for barbecues. A serene guest bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and Smart TV is on this level—early risers will love the private back porch, which leads out to a walking trail. A washer and dryer add convenience for extended stays.Ascend to the second floor to find a sunny primary bedroom and charming guest bedroom, each featuring a plush king bed, private bathroom, Smart TV, and private balcony. In the hall is a bunk nook with a twin-over-twin bed.On the third level, an open space with a Roku-equipped TV, queen-over-queen bunk bed, wet bar, and beverage cooler offers ideal accommodations for young adults or social guests who don’t mind sharing space. Step onto the private balcony to enjoy peaceful views of the neighborhood.With luxurious amenities, charming accommodations, and plenty of outdoor spaces, Sandy Pants is the perfect property for a joyful Seacrest Beach vacation. Leisurely explore with parking for 2 vehicles and 4 complimentary adult bikes. Access to the beach is via the Villas at Sunset Beach, directly south of Seacrest Beach. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Half BathroomSECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with separate Shower and Tub-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Additional Sleeping Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*This home is only allotted 12 wristbands.*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian.
